title: [Bug]: problems with getting started example code
body:
### Describe the bug

Docs link: https://docs.ag2.ai/0.9.9/docs/quick-start/
Ag2 version: 0.9.9

```python
llm_config = LLMConfig({"api_type": "openai", "model": "gpt-5-nano"})
```
should be 

```python
llm_config = LLMConfig(config_list={"api_type": "openai", "model": "gpt-5-nano"})
```
